summary: Kim Caudle Lewis is a lifelong Madison County resident who ran for the Alabama Senate District 2 seat in the 2022 election. She was the chief executive and co-founder of a local technology and engineering company, as well as the first Black woman to chair the Huntsville/Madison County Chamber of Commerce. During her campaign, she prioritized education reform following *Dobbs* for reproductive rights protection.
